text: In the jito-tip-distribution program, initialize_tip_distribution_account stores validator_commission_bps and rejects values above the config's max_validator_commission_bps (MaxValidatorCommissionFeeBpsExceeded). The shown source never computes the split: claim pays whatever amount a merkle proof verifies against the root that the merkle_root_upload_authority uploaded, so the staker/validator split is fixed off-chain when the tree is built (TipRouter operators reach consensus on each epoch's distribution). (medium confidence)
keywords: Validator selection commission and MEV tip sharing

text: Since SIMD-0096 went live in early 2025, the leader keeps 100% of priority fees. No protocol rule passes them to stakers, so any sharing is voluntary and outside the core protocol. Jito tips were the one reward stream already shared through a distribution program. In Jan 2025 a Jito-side author (Lucas Bruder) estimated that tips raised staking rewards 25-50% in recent epochs, with more than $950M distributed to date. (high confidence)
